set.body: Bugs found during the visual gallery gate: derived axis labels overflow reserved strips because defaults are native-span fractions, while legend labels/title can collide with point-sized keys because spacing shrinks with the viewport. Replace default axis offsets with typed absolute extents tied to LayoutPolicy, retain absolute legend spacing, and add device-space regression tests across viewport sizes. Acceptance: tests independently assert point-invariant tick/label offsets and key/label/title clearances; focused graphics and graphics-svg gates pass on JVM and JS; commit only the narrow guide slice.
set.title: Graphics: make derived guide geometry device-invariant
